Product:{\"sku\":\"7100126215\"}.description({\"html\":true}):
[Game Overview]
While inheriting the core system of the Old Coin Pusher Friends series, this title offers a fresh and unique gameplay experience.

Strengthen your samurai in the village, prepare your set of Action Spheres, and head into the cave.

During exploration, you’ll encounter enemies, discover treasure chests, and experience various events.

Your goal is to delve deeper into the cave.

This game is primarily single‑player. Only Raid Battles support online multiplayer.

[Core System]
Shoot Coins to push other Coins forward.

You only obtain Coins that fall into the collection box—anything that doesn’t enter the box is not acquired.

[Action System]
Collect Action Spheres to activate their effects.

These include attacking enemies, restoring HP, recovering Hunger, and many other abilities.

[Multiplayer]
A Raid Battle mode where up to four players fight The formidable together.

Supports Quick Match and Friend Match.

Solo play is also available.

[Relics (Rewards)]
Defeating The formidable may cause Relics with special effects to appear.

Relics are also obtained by shooting Coins, pushing them out, and collecting them in the box.

[Growth Elements]
Defeat enemies to gain experience and level up, increasing your samurai’s stats.

You can also enhance equipment using Coins.
